paper_title: The first search for bosonic super-WIMPs with masses up to 1 MeV/c$^2$ with GERDA
notes: GERDA search for keV-scale bosonic super-WIMPs (60 keV - 1 MeV) via axioelectric absorption in HPGe detectors, 58.9 kg-yr exposure (14.6 kg-yr below 200 keV). Paper sets 90% credible interval upper limits on both g_ae (ALP-electron, Fig 3 top) and alpha'/alpha (dark photon, Fig 3 bottom); the AxionElectron interpretation is reported here per the hint. Only one explicit numerical value is given in the text: g_ae < 3e-12 at m_a = 150 keV/c^2 (1.5e5 eV). The full mass-dependent limit curve exists only in Fig 3 (g_ae roughly 1e-12 to 1e-11 over 60 keV - 1 MeV, weakening at high mass due to falling photoelectric cross section) and would require plot digitization. The dark photon result (alpha'/alpha < 6.5e-24 at 150 keV, note alpha'/alpha = kappa^2, so chi ~ 2.5e-12) is a separate DarkPhoton limit not encoded here.
